WITH date_dim_1998 AS (
    SELECT d_date_sk
    FROM date_dim
    WHERE d_year = 1998
),
web_sales_filtered AS (
    SELECT ws_item_sk,
           ws_order_number,
           ws_quantity,
           ws_sales_price,
           ws_net_profit,
           ws_web_page_sk,
           ws_sold_date_sk
    FROM web_sales
    WHERE (
        ws_sales_price BETWEEN 100.00 AND 150.00
        OR ws_sales_price BETWEEN 50.00 AND 100.00
        OR ws_sales_price BETWEEN 150.00 AND 200.00
    )
    AND (
        ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100 AND 200
        OR ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150 AND 300
        OR ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50 AND 250
    )
),
ws_returns AS (
    SELECT
        ws.ws_quantity,
        ws.ws_sales_price,
        ws.ws_net_profit,
        ws.ws_web_page_sk,
        ws.ws_sold_date_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_cash,
        wr.wr_fee,
        wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk,
        wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk,
        wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk,
        wr.wr_reason_sk
    FROM web_sales_filtered AS ws
    JOIN web_returns AS wr
      ON ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk
     AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number
),
valid_cd AS (
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'D' AND cd_education_status = 'Primary'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'S' AND cd_education_status = 'College'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cd_demo_sk, cd_marital_status, cd_education_status
    FROM customer_demographics
    WHERE cd_marital_status = 'U' AND cd_education_status = 'Advanced Degree'
),
cd_status_price AS (
    SELECT 'D' AS cd1_marital_status,
           'Primary' AS cd1_education_status,
           'D' AS cd2_marital_status,
           'Primary' AS cd2_education_status,
           100.00 AS price_low,
           150.00 AS price_high
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'S', 'College', 'S', 'College', 50.00, 100.00
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'U', 'Advanced Degree', 'U', 'Advanced Degree', 150.00, 200.00
),
address_match AS (
    SELECT ca_address_sk, ca_country, ca_state
    FROM customer_address
    WHERE ca_country = 'United States'
      AND ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA', 'WI', 'WV', 'GA', 'OK', 'VA', 'KY')
),
address_profit AS (
    SELECT 'United States' AS ca_country,
           'NC' AS ca_state,
           100 AS profit_low,
           200 AS profit_high
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'TX', 100, 200
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'IA', 100, 200
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'WI', 150, 300
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'WV', 150, 300
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'GA', 150, 300
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'OK', 50, 250
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'VA', 50, 250
    UNION ALL SELECT 'United States', 'KY', 50, 250
),
reason_preagg AS (
    SELECT
        sr.wr_reason_sk,
        COUNT(sr.ws_quantity) AS ws_qty_count,
        SUM(sr.ws_quantity) AS ws_qty_sum,
        COUNT(sr.wr_refunded_cash) AS refund_cash_count,
        SUM(sr.wr_refunded_cash) AS refund_cash_sum,
        COUNT(sr.wr_fee) AS fee_count,
        SUM(sr.wr_fee) AS fee_sum
    FROM ws_returns AS sr
    JOIN web_page AS wp
      ON sr.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk
    JOIN date_dim_1998 AS d
      ON sr.ws_sold_date_sk = d.d_date_sk
    JOIN valid_cd AS cd1
      ON cd1.cd_demo_sk = sr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk
    JOIN cd_status_price AS csp
      ON csp.cd1_marital_status = cd1.cd_marital_status
     AND csp.cd1_education_status = cd1.cd_education_status
     AND sr.ws_sales_price BETWEEN csp.price_low AND csp.price_high
    JOIN valid_cd AS cd2
      ON cd2.cd_demo_sk = sr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk
     AND cd2.cd_marital_status = csp.cd2_marital_status
     AND cd2.cd_education_status = csp.cd2_education_status
    JOIN address_match AS ca
      ON ca.ca_address_sk = sr.wr_refunded_addr_sk
    JOIN address_profit AS ap
      ON ap.ca_country = ca.ca_country
     AND ap.ca_state = ca.ca_state
     AND sr.ws_net_profit BETWEEN ap.profit_low AND ap.profit_high
    GROUP BY sr.wr_reason_sk
)
SELECT
    substr(r.r_reason_desc, 1, 20) AS `substr(r_reason_desc,1,20)`,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ra.ws_qty_count) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(ra.ws_qty_sum) / SUM(ra.ws_qty_count)
    END AS `avg(ws_quantity)`,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ra.refund_cash_count) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(ra.refund_cash_sum) / SUM(ra.refund_cash_count)
    END AS `avg(wr_refunded_cash)`,
    CASE WHEN SUM(ra.fee_count) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE SUM(ra.fee_sum) / SUM(ra.fee_count)
    END AS `avg(wr_fee)`
FROM reason_preagg AS ra
JOIN reason AS r
  ON r.r_reason_sk = ra.wr_reason_sk
GROUP BY r.r_reason_desc
ORDER BY `substr(r_reason_desc,1,20)`,
         `avg(ws_quantity)`,
         `avg(wr_refunded_cash)`,
         `avg(wr_fee)`
LIMIT 100
